entries.zh: 活水；泉眼湧出的水（agua manantial 指源頭不斷流出的活水）
entries.en: spring water; running (living) water from a spring

entries.zh: 濁水；渾濁不清的水
entries.en: turbid water; muddy, unclear water

entries.zh: 熱水；燙水（用於燙洗褪毛、去皮的開水）
entries.en: hot water (for scalding, e.g. to pluck poultry or scrape hides)

entries.zh: 湯水；熱水、燙水（同前條，加「水」字成詞）
entries.en: hot water; scalding water (same as the preceding, with 水 added)

entries.zh: 清澈的流水、活水（原稿漢字作「洚」）
entries.en: clear running water; limpid flowing water
entries.notes: 「洚」本義為洪水漫溢，與西語「清澈流動的水」不合，取西語與對音定奪，故降級。

entries.zh: 清水；清澈的流水（同前條，加「水」字成詞）
entries.en: clear water; limpid running water (same as the preceding)
entries.notes: 同第 5 條，「洚」字與西語語義不合，僅依對音與 L 欄定奪。

entries.zh: 洪水；溢出河道、漫出兩岸的河水
entries.en: flood; river water that has burst its banks

entries.zh: （水）澄清、沉澱後變清
entries.en: to clear, to settle and become clear (of water)
entries.notes: 西語欄原文「aguas muchas aguas. digo aclararse」為原稿自行刪改之文，取改後「aclararse」之義。

entries.zh: 澄清；使水變清、濾清
entries.en: to clarify; to make water clear
entries.notes: 西語欄同為原稿刪改後之文句，依「澄清」與 aclararse 互證定奪。

entries.zh: 濫水；漫溢泛濫的水，水多而四溢
entries.en: overflowing water; flood water spreading beyond its course
entries.notes: 西語欄首字「Gua」為 agua 之省寫，且全條文句不完整，故降級。

entries.zh: 水勢盛大；豐沛的大水、雨水
entries.en: abundant water; copious rain or flood water

entries.zh: 薔薇露；玫瑰花蒸餾所得的香露
entries.en: rose water (distilled from roses)

entries.zh: 湖海之水；湖泊與海的水（西語作「河與海」）
entries.en: water of lake and sea; river and sea water
entries.notes: 西語作「河與海」，漢字作「湖海」，二者所指略異，依漢字定 zh、依西語定 en。

entries.zh: 船漏水；滲入船艙的水（船身發漏進水）
entries.en: water leaking into the ship; the ship taking in water

entries.zh: 符水；神像前祝禱過的「聖水」（異教神明的加持水）
entries.en: blessed water of an idol; Taoist talismanic water

entries.zh: 淺水；水淺之處、水不深的地方
entries.en: shallow water; water of little depth

entries.zh: 死水；不流動、終將乾涸的積水
entries.en: stagnant water; standing water that dries up and does not run

entries.zh: 糖水；蜂蜜水或加糖的水
entries.en: honey water; sugar water; sweetened water

entries.zh: 驟雨；突如其來的一陣急雨
entries.en: sudden downpour; a rain squall

entries.zh: 帶風的陣雨；風雨交作的一陣雨
entries.en: rain shower accompanied by wind
entries.notes: 漢字作「方時雨」，而閩南音首節 hong 近「風」，西語明言 con viento，字面與釋義不盡合，故降級。

entries.zh: 〔原件疑誤，釋義存疑〕或指自石孔、泉口湧出的水
entries.en: uncertain (text corrupt): water issuing from a rock spout or spring
entries.notes: 西語「agua manil de pico」不成詞，漢字「干砳」罕見，閩南音 cán phy̌ 亦難還原，四欄無法互證。
